verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere's own SDK and CLI run models entirely on the user's hardware, offline and without an account, so the on-device core needs no vendor infrastructure. The evidence does not show a way to self-host the hosted Wally Cloud / OpenAI-compatible endpoint, and community notes that the MetalRT engine is commercial limit how open the self-hosted stack is. Missing for 10: documented self-hosted server deployment of the hosted/Cloud endpoint, self-hosting install and ops docs, independent corroboration of a fully self-run deployment.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Prompts, audio, and images stay on the phone, and everything keeps working with no network.
When a small model on your own machine is enough, the same CLI runs it, offline and without an account.
Private by default. Offline by design.
